# Commit lint allowlist
#
# Commits listed here are exempt from the Conventional Commits gate.
#
# Rationale
#   Every entry below is already published on a long-lived branch (`dev`) and
#   rewriting it would require a force-push, which this repository forbids.
#   The gate cannot be satisfied retroactively, so the offending commits are
#   recorded here instead of silently bypassing the whole check.
#
# Policy
#   * Append-only. Never remove an entry to "clean up" the file.
#   * Only historical, already-published commits belong here. A new commit must
#     be written in `type(scope): subject` form instead of being added here.
#   * Keep the reason on the same line: it is what makes this file auditable.
#   * Prefix matching is supported (7-40 hex chars), but full 40-char SHAs are
#     preferred so an entry can never accidentally match another commit.
#
# Format
#   <sha>  <reason>
#

2ad8b2931ca07e56ecb5b8675fd13377006011c8  header "unify test disk selection guard into libs/locallibs/disk_select_lib.sh" has no "type:" prefix
4d2beaa74f23e1741fda040b6642db61ad6b3edb  header "testcases: harden Group C server-side cases and re-triage Group E" uses unsupported type "testcases"
bed7041c137148dbc2c829f932b080117433372a  header "httpd: drop cases for units not shipped by openRuyi spec" uses unsupported type "httpd"
